evidence.answer: My partner showed me Kitchen Light. The rough guitar and the lyrics grabbed me.

response.message: Good one to start with. Kitchen Light has travelled a lot on people sending it to someone they missed, and the scrappy live recording is a big part of that. It's about getting back to a shared flat after a bad night and finding someone stayed up. Was there a line that grabbed you, or was it more the roughness of the guitar?

details.discovery: Their partner showed them Kitchen Light
details.connection: The rough guitar and the lyrics of Kitchen Light grabbed them

evidence.answer: It reminds me of a friend staying up after a long day.

response.message: That's a lovely way into it. The song never needs to be about a flat for it to land; it's the small act of someone leaving a light on for you. It's why people send it to each other. They're also heading out on their biggest tour this spring, and I'm curious whether you'd fancy hearing it live. Where would you be travelling from?

details.discovery: Their partner showed them Kitchen Light
details.connection: Kitchen Light reminds them of a friend staying up after a long day

evidence.answer: We both want to see them live.

response.message: Good, that makes it easy. They're keen to keep the closeness of the early Railway Rooms nights on this tour, even though it's their biggest yet, so it should be a good one to share. Where would the two of you be setting off from?

details.discovery: Their partner showed them Kitchen Light
details.connection: Kitchen Light reminds them of a friend staying up after a long day

evidence.answer: We're coming from Bristol, and we want to see them in London.

response.message: London it is, and that feels right for a band who spent eight years in small south London rooms. There are two nights there, Saturday 17 April and Sunday 18 April. Which would suit the two of you better for the trip up from Bristol?

details.discovery: Their partner showed them Kitchen Light
details.connection: Kitchen Light reminds them of a friend staying up after a long day

response.message: Saturday 17 April in London, then, for the two of you, coming up from Bristol. I'll note that as your preference. Nothing's reserved and no tickets are held, it's just where you'd like to be. If you fancy some homework before the night, Last Bus Home closes their set. It builds slowly, all about stretching a journey out because you're not ready for the evening to end. It might be a good one to hear before you travel. Has your partner got a favourite, or is Kitchen Light the one you're both stuck on?

details.discovery: Their partner showed them Kitchen Light
details.connection: Kitchen Light reminds them of a friend staying up after a long day

response.message: Lovely, enjoy the build-up and the trip up from Bristol. Have a great night on the 17th, and say hello to your partner for me. Bye for now!
